brief: Escalating conflicts in the West Bank and Iran, along with wildfires in the US and Europe, dominate the news. Research focuses on usability of AI in product advice, political mapping, and creative writing tools.
news_summary: Tensions rise with killings in the West Bank, a credible Iranian threat forcing Trump's plane switch, and wildfires in Oregon, France, and Spain. Paramount pauses Warner merger, Democrats revamp primary calendar, ICC removes chief prosecutor, and measles cases hit a US record.
papers_summary: Studies explore usability of LLM-based product advisors, geographic-legislative association needs, wearable AI for fiction writing, and augmented reality for deaf students. Other papers cover data visualization languages, clinical workflow optimization, and ethical AI for dementia care.

zh.brief: 今日新聞聚焦美中AI技術竊取指控、美國對60個貿易夥伴課徵新關稅，以及紅海航運危機加劇；研究方面關注AI在產品推薦、創意寫作及醫療照護中的應用與倫理。
zh.news_summary: 美國指控中國AI公司「月之暗面」竊取Anthropic技術，並以強迫勞動為由對60個貿易夥伴加徵關稅；胡塞武裝威脅曼德海峽可能引發紅海航運危機。
zh.papers_summary: 多篇論文探討AI在對話式產品顧問、創意寫作輔助及失智症照護中的應用，強調可用性、透明性與倫理議題。
